::: {.tagline}
Math and analytics for fire & EMS
:::

<!-- Alternative tagline: "Statistics, simulation, and optimization for public safety" -->

I'm a data analyst at Cobb County Fire & Emergency Services in Georgia, where I've worked on incident data and reporting for eight years. I'm interested in anywhere math and analytics meet public safety: statistics, simulation, and optimization problems like where to place units and how to measure response times honestly. I'm still learning a lot of it, and this site is where I write up what I learn and share projects.
